description: This Java class acts as a command handler for updating the delinquency bucket of a loan within the Fineract platform. It processes a command to modify the delinquency status of a loan and interacts with the DelinquencyWritePlatformService.

classes.name: UpdateLoanDelinquencyBucketCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service class that handles commands to update the delinquency bucket of loans, implementing command processing logic and transaction management.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the command to update a loan's delinquency bucket by invoking the DelinquencyWritePlatformService.
